anchor: Understand explicit textual differences that predict Pangram outcomes; do not substitute owner style preference or actual authorship.
owner_authority: Continue hypothesis-driven research; API only 1–3 paragraphs per submission; no long sections or articles.
methods: Three source-family local comparisons, including a two-factor four-cell adjacent-paragraph test. Current Chat predictions; no independent benchmark or reviewer claim. Separate evaluator route was previously blocked and is not retried.
question: Does compressing source-supported development into a more coordinated or abstract formulation change labels while keeping claims, examples, imagery and paragraph count?
hypotheses: M: packing either paragraph may be insufficient, while packing both may increase non-Human classification; old evidence mixed wording with changed meanings, so these variants retain the owner example set and causal claim.
C: packing three cultural actions into one coordinated sentence may make the same causal image less Human-likely. Word count and both metaphors are nearly fixed.
R: compressing the reader comparison into a single consideration may make its literal causal invitation less Human-likely, even with other claims fixed.
primary_outcome: All returned windows Human versus any non-Human window. Document headline and raw fraction_ai retained separately, not authorship probability.
secondary: Paired word-count differences, confidence categories, exact unchanged-context label changes.

intervention_limits: Operation packages alter wording and syntax together. C minimizes word-count/imagery changes. The comparison tests specific realizations, not a universal law. No new claims, jokes, biographies, examples or deliberate errors are licensed.
stopping_rule: Measure the eight frozen cells once or reuse exact current cached results. No tuning after observing outcomes. Additional work requires a genuinely different evidence-backed decision.
